dataset_name: NASA Capacitor Electrical Stress Degradation Dataset
source: NASA Ames Research Center, Prognostics Center of Excellence (PCoE)
original_paper: Celaya et al. (2012) 'Towards A Model-based Prognostics Methodology for Electrolytic Capacitors', PHM Society; Renwick et al. (2015)
observation_count: Thousands of continuous charge/discharge cycles and EIS sweeps
units: uF, Ohms, Volts, Seconds, Hz, deg C
environmental_conditions: Controlled electrical overstress (10V, 12V, 14V) with thermal monitoring
static_limit_standard: MIL-PRF-62F / Vishay standard: Delta C <= -20% or ESR >= 2.0 * ESR0
major_limitations: 24 total discrete components across 3 stress groups; stress mode is electrical overstress rather than multi-axis vibration/thermal ESS profile.

dataset_name: NASA MOSFET Thermal Overstress Aging Dataset
source: NASA Ames Research Center, Prognostics Center of Excellence (PCoE)
original_paper: Celaya, J. R., Saxena, A., Saha, S., & Goebel, K. (2011). 'Prognostics of Power MOSFETs under Thermal-Stress Accelerated Aging', IEEE Aerospace Conference
observation_count: Tens of thousands of power/thermal cycles across 6 run-to-failure devices
environmental_conditions: Accelerated thermal overstress cycling (high junction temperature excursions)
static_limit_standard: Datasheet limit: Rds(on) max = 0.20 Ohms (+20% delta limit over nominal)
major_limitations: Very small component sample size (6 devices); while temporal depth is high, population/lot statistics are constrained by sample count.

dataset_name: UCI SECOM Semiconductor Manufacturing Operational Dataset
original_paper: McCann, M., Li, Y., Maguire, L., & Johnston, A. (2008). 'Causality Extraction from a Semiconductor Manufacturing Operational Database', IEEE T-CAD
environmental_conditions: Semiconductor fabrication cleanroom in-line process conditions
static_limit_standard: Engineering specification control limits on individual key sensor channels
major_limitations: Cross-sectional snapshot data with no temporal component degradation; cannot evaluate burn-in or time-series degradation trajectories.

dataset_name: SEMATECH S-121 Iddq Semiconductor Test Data
source_url: Academic distribution via Texas A&M University (Sabade & Walker archive)
original_paper: Sabade, S., & Walker, D. M. H. (2002). 'Evaluation of Statistical Outlier Rejection Methods for Iddq Testing', IEEE ITC; Daasch et al. (2001)
static_limit_standard: Single global Iddq threshold (e.g. 5 uA or 10 uA)
major_limitations: Benchmark dataset from 1997 not openly accessible via standardized public direct download repository without institutional request.

dataset_name: IEEE DataPort Power Cycling Test Dataset (GEOL)
source: IEEE DataPort / Aalborg University (Prof. Frede Blaabjerg Group)
original_paper: Xiang, D. et al. (2021). 'Power Cycling Test Dataset for IGBT/SiC Power Modules', IEEE DataPort
observation_count: Continuous high-frequency cycle logging until solder fatigue/bond liftoff
static_limit_standard: Vce_on increase >= 5% or 20% thermal impedance increase
major_limitations: Restricted access behind IEEE account authentication, smaller module-level focus rather than discrete electronic screening.
